description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #4: tabadmintest, authorized only by the ego.table.admin grant from perm-66c (no identity-wide ego.dsn.admin, no dsns_auth record for this DSN at all), reads its own permissions on t{{PERMTESTID}}. Before the fix, ReadPermissions' route was gated by Permissions(defs.DSNAdminPermission) alone, which only ever checks identity-wide permissions, so this exact request was rejected before the handler ever ran -- making ego.table.admin unusable for the self-service purpose docs/SERVER.md describes it for.
